@@ -119,6 +119,47 @@ further daemon state (e.g. Triton warmup caches or weight manifests) plugs in
 as additional kinds — small JSON payloads travel inline, while large binary
 state rides the data plane.
 
+### Sharing warmup caches through Mooncake (optional)
+
+D2D seeding needs a live source daemon. As an alternative, the daemon can
+share its warmup caches through pluggable shared stores, so a new node can
+fetch them even when no source replica is online. `--warmup-cache-stores`
+takes a comma-separated list of store backends; the `mooncake` backend uses
+a [Mooncake](https://github.com/kvcache-ai/Mooncake) distributed store.
+Point `MOONCAKE_CONFIG_PATH` at the same JSON configuration used by
+[MooncakeStoreConnector](mooncake_store_connector_usage.md#configure-mooncake):
+
+```bash
+MOONCAKE_CONFIG_PATH=/path/to/mooncake_config.json \
+vllm preload --model /path/to/model --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
+    --warmup-cache-stores mooncake
+```
+
+After tuning, each daemon publishes its per-rank autotune table to every
+configured store under keys of the form
+`vllm-warmup-cache/<kind>/<config-hash>/<filename>`, in addition to writing
+its local disk cache. All tiers share one interface: the local disk is
+always tier zero, and the stores listed in `--warmup-cache-stores`
+follow it in list order — reads take the first tier that hits, writes fan
+out to all of them. During warmup a daemon pulls its table from the shared stores first, in
+list order; when no store has it — or none are configured — it falls back
+to D2D seeding from a live source daemon, and finally tunes in place.
+Stores come first because they are built for read fan-out, while a D2D
+fetch makes a busy peer proxy the same bytes. This covers a cold start
+with no live source daemon and nodes whose cache root is ephemeral. When
+serving peers, a daemon answers from the same chain: disk first, then the
+stores. Whatever it fetches is validated and installed to the local disk
+cache as usual. A misspelled store name or a store that cannot be
+configured fails daemon startup immediately; at runtime, store operations
+are best-effort and never block warmup.
+
+Prefer the `standalone-store` topology for this use case. In `embedded` mode
+every daemon contributes `global_segment_size` of host memory to the pool,
+which is hard to justify for kilobyte-sized JSON artifacts. Note that the
+store is a trust boundary: any writer in the Mooncake cluster can influence
+the autotune tables other nodes load, so only point daemons at a trusted
+deployment.
+
 ## How it works

+def _mooncake_peer(key: str, payload: bytes, mode: str) -> None:
+    """Second-process body: put/get through a real MooncakeArtifactStore."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.weight_cache.artifact_store import (
+        MooncakeArtifactStore,
+    )

+class MooncakeCluster:
+    """A real mooncake master plus a standalone-store segment owner."""
+
+    def __init__(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+        self._tmp_path = tmp_path
+        self._monkeypatch = monkeypatch
+        self._procs: list[subprocess.Popen] = []
+        self._log_chunks: list[str] = []
+
+    def _binary(self, name: str) -> str:
+        path = shutil.which(name)
+        if path is not None:
+            return path
+        try:
+            import mooncake
+        except ImportError:
+            pytest.skip("mooncake is not installed")
+        candidate = Path(mooncake.__file__).parent / name
+        if not candidate.exists():
+            pytest.skip(f"the {name} binary is not available")
+        return str(candidate)
+
+    def __enter__(self) -> "MooncakeCluster":
+        self.master_port = get_open_port()
+        self.master_addr = f"127.0.0.1:{self.master_port}"
+        self._start(
+            [
+                self._binary("mooncake_master"),
+                "-port",
+                str(self.master_port),
+                "-metrics_port",
+                str(get_open_port()),
+            ]
+        )
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
+        while True:
+            try:
+                socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", self.master_port), timeout=1)
+                break
+            except OSError:
+                if time.monotonic() > deadline:
+                    raise RuntimeError(
+                        f"mooncake_master did not start:\n{self.logs}"
+                    ) from None
+                time.sleep(0.2)
+
+        config = {
+            "metadata_server": "P2PHANDSHAKE",
+            "master_server_address": self.master_addr,
+            "protocol": "tcp",
+            "mode": "standalone-store",
+            "global_segment_size": 0,
+            "local_buffer_size": "16MB",
+        }
+        config_path = self._tmp_path / "mooncake.json"
+        config_path.write_text(json.dumps(config))
+        self._monkeypatch.setenv("MOONCAKE_CONFIG_PATH", str(config_path))
+        self._monkeypatch.setenv(
+            "VLLM_FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE_CACHE_DIR", str(self._tmp_path / "disk_cache")
+        )
+        self._start(
+            [
+                self._binary("mooncake_client"),
+                "-master_server_address",
+                self.master_addr,
+                "-metadata_server",
+                "P2PHANDSHAKE",
+                "-protocol",
+                "tcp",
+                "-global_segment_size",
+                "256MB",
+            ]
+        )
+
+        # The store round-trips only after the client has mounted its segment.
+        store = MooncakeArtifactStore()
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + 60
+        while True:
+            store.put("vllm-warmup-cache/probe", b"ok")
+            if store.get("vllm-warmup-cache/probe") == b"ok":
+                return self
+            if time.monotonic() > deadline:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"mooncake store is not ready:\n{self.logs}")
+            time.sleep(0.5)
+
+    def __exit__(self, *exc_info) -> None:
+        for proc in reversed(self._procs):
+            proc.terminate()
+        for proc in self._procs:
+            try:
+                proc.wait(timeout=10)
+            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+                proc.kill()
+
+    @property
+    def logs(self) -> str:
+        return "".join(self._log_chunks)
+
+    def _start(self, cmd: list[str]) -> None:
+        proc = subprocess.Popen(
+            cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True
+        )
+        self._procs.append(proc)
+        threading.Thread(target=self._drain, args=(proc,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _drain(self, proc: subprocess.Popen) -> None:
+        assert proc.stdout is not None
+        for line in proc.stdout:
+            self._log_chunks.append(line)
+
+    def run_peer(self, key: str, payload: bytes, mode: str) -> None:
+        """Drive a second MooncakeArtifactStore in a separate process."""
+        proc = multiprocessing.get_context("spawn").Process(
+            target=_mooncake_peer, args=(key, payload, mode)
+        )
+        proc.start()
+        proc.join(timeout=180)
+        if proc.is_alive():
+            proc.kill()
+            raise TimeoutError(f"peer {mode} timed out:\n{self.logs}")
+        assert proc.exitcode == 0, f"peer {mode} failed (see captured stderr)"
+

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Storage backends for daemon warmup-cache artifacts (disk and shared stores)."""
+
+import os
+import tempfile
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from contextlib import suppress
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Protocol
+
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.mooncake import rdma_utils
+from vllm.distributed.mooncake_store import MooncakeStoreConfig, setup_mooncake_store
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.utils.import_utils import PlaceholderModule
+from vllm.utils.network_utils import get_ip
+
+try:
+    from mooncake.store import MooncakeDistributedStore
+except ImportError:
+    mooncake_store = PlaceholderModule("mooncake.store")  # type: ignore[assignment]
+    MooncakeDistributedStore = mooncake_store.placeholder_attr(
+        "MooncakeDistributedStore"
+    )
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+_KEY_PREFIX = "vllm-warmup-cache"
+
+
+def artifact_key(kind: str, config_hash: str, filename: str) -> str:
+    """Canonical key for one warmup-cache artifact, valid in every store."""
+    return f"{_KEY_PREFIX}/{kind}/{config_hash}/{filename}"
+
+
+class ArtifactStore(Protocol):
+    """One warmup-cache artifact store: bytes in and out, keyed by artifact_key."""
+
+    name: str
+
+    def get(self, key: str) -> bytes | None:
+        """Fetch the artifact, or None on a miss."""
+        ...
+
+    def put(self, key: str, data: bytes) -> None:
+        """Publish the artifact under the key."""
+        ...
+
+
+class DiskArtifactStore(ArtifactStore):
+    """The local disk store: one directory tree per warmup-cache kind."""
+
+    name = "disk"
+
+    def __init__(self, kind: str, root: Path):
+        self._prefix = f"{_KEY_PREFIX}/{kind}/"
+        self._root = root
+
+    def _path(self, key: str) -> Path:
+        rel = key.removeprefix(self._prefix)
+        parts = rel.split("/")
+        if rel == key or len(parts) != 2 or any(p in ("", ".", "..") for p in parts):
+            raise ValueError(f"key {key!r} is outside this store")
+        return self._root / parts[0] / parts[1]
+
+    def get(self, key: str) -> bytes | None:
+        path = self._path(key)
+        return path.read_bytes() if path.is_file() else None
+
+    def put(self, key: str, data: bytes) -> None:
+        path = self._path(key)
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(
+            dir=path.parent, suffix=".tmp", prefix=f".{path.name}."
+        )
+        try:
+            with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as f:
+                f.write(data)
+            os.replace(tmp_path, path)
+        except BaseException:
+            with suppress(OSError):
+                os.unlink(tmp_path)
+            raise
+

+    """MooncakeDistributedStore wrapper via MOONCAKE_CONFIG_PATH."""

+
+    def get(self, key: str) -> bytes | None:
+        """Fetch the artifact; a miss or a native error reads as empty."""
+        return self._store.get(key) or None
+
+    def put(self, key: str, data: bytes) -> None:
+        """Publish the artifact; first writer wins, so publishers are idempotent."""
+        if self._store.is_exist(key) == 1:
+            return
+        ret = self._store.put(key, data)
+        if ret != 0 and self._store.is_exist(key) != 1:
+            logger.warning("Mooncake artifact put %s failed (ret=%d)", key, ret)

+STORE_BACKENDS: dict[str, Callable[[], ArtifactStore]] = {
+    "mooncake": MooncakeArtifactStore,
+}
